description: Factory class for creating VoicemailFilter objects for various filtering scenarios, including creating filters with where clauses, matching specific voicemail fields, and combining filters with logical AND/OR operations.

classes.name: VoicemailFilterFactory
classes.description: A factory class providing static methods to generate VoicemailFilter objects based on different criteria, including raw where clauses, specific fields, and combinations of multiple filters.

methods.name: createWithWhereClause
methods.description: Creates a VoicemailFilter that applies a specified where clause directly. Use if you know the exact column names and clauses.

methods.name: createWithMatchingFields
methods.description: Creates a VoicemailFilter that matches fields set in the provided Voicemail object.

methods.name: createWithReadStatus
methods.description: Generates a VoicemailFilter based on the read/unread status.

methods.name: createWithAndOf
methods.description: Combines multiple VoicemailFilters with a logical AND.

methods.name: createWithOrOf
methods.description: Combines multiple VoicemailFilters with a logical OR.
